notes.title: Diluvian Winds - 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's been a week since Diluvian Winds has been released.
Thank you all for you feedback.
Here is a quick update with several issues patched.
We will keep fixing bugs and add QoL changes to the game. Our next goal is to port the game to consoles.
Once again, thank you very much for the support you gave to us during this week .
Have a nice game !

DILUVIAN WINDS - 1.1.0

Release date: 03/05/2024

This update aims to fix some gameplay issues and improve the overall quality of life in the game.

BUG FIXES

BLOCKER

 -Fixed an issue with the game being stuck on a black screen during Chapter 5

HIGH

 -Fixed an issue with the save file being automatically deleted
 -Fixed an issue with the game being overly saturated with some computer configuration

MEDIUM

 -Weather with morale maluses won’t spawn during the two first game
 -Fixed an issue with the achievement : The first of many not being unlocked when obtaining an artifact during Chapter 8
 -Fixed an issue with clearing yields not being updated when unlocking a related project
 -Fixed an issue with chapter-related achievements not being retroactive

LOW

 -Textile production bonuses are now correctly displayed when using the Fabric workshop
 -Fixed “Chap 7: Aloft” achievement title
 -Fixed “Architectural pride” achievement korean description
 -Fixed “Sparing no expense” achievement description
 -Fixed value required to unlock the "Expedition souvenirs" steam achievement
 -Fixed value required to unlock the "Expedition gifts" steam achievement
 -Fixed Wave Level 3 description
 -Frog species’ icon is now correctly displayed
 -Colored powder artifacts are now correctly applied
 -Fixed a typo in some french dialogues

notes.title: ✨ Roadmap update and Autumn Sale 🍂
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

After the latest update that we released a few days ago and that you can find here, we thought it would be great to provide you with an ✨ updated roadmap ✨ to see where we are in the early access journey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/e7205ba7cb107ea3199d3624d4cc1bd0db0d2f47.png

As you can see, we're currently in the middle of early access, and the next big update will feature the following new content:

 Chapters 7 & 8
 5 Aerial Species
 A new element to build: the Aeronautics Workshop
 Two new features: Expeditions* & Artifacts*.

*Expeditions: Sending Travelers to regions of the world to collect resources, research, or artifacts.
*Artifacts: Powerful consumables that the player can use at various points in the game.

You can expect to know the exact release date in the next few weeks! 
In the meantime, enjoy a 25% discount on the game, as well as on the entire Goblinz catalog during the Autumn Sale! 🍂

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561040/Diluvian_Winds/

Thank you for your support! 🤎

notes.title: 🦝 The Merchant Update is here!
notes.notes:
Diluvian Winds’ second major update is here!

In this update, we've introduced a brand-new addition to the game: the Merchants. These adorable yet fearless adventurers sail the seas to engage in trade. Despite their friendly appearance, don't underestimate their business acumen – they are shrewd entrepreneurs!

Summary


 A new game mechanic: the Merchants
 A new chapter to introduce them
 New Merchants-related projects
 5 new Merchant species


/!\ KNOWN BUGS /!\


 Localization is not complete for some languages
 Saves from older versions may not be compatible


THE MERCHANTS

The Merchants are brave travelers who traverse the world in their boats.
They offer to trade goods with the lighthouse in return for a place to dock for a few days.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/4c5abae75d51c6bedd09ab2b27400bb56b06b1ca.gif

They organize themselves into guilds, and each guild specializes in specific types of goods. You can enhance your relationship with a particular guild by trading with its affiliated merchants. This will unlock more trade options, sales, and even gifts along the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/7c79ae588c898580e92aa0fc329d8200e4686627.png


CHANGES AND BUG FIXES
[expand type=CHANGES AND BUG FIXES]
Travelers


 Travelers can now move rooms. Doing it counts as an action for the day (like producing resources) and has a cost.
 A colored cover appears when using some actions on rooms (Blue : Reinforce, White : Move, Red : Clear)
 Improved traveler’s pathfinding
 Clearing debris won’t make the game crash in some situations
 The traveler’s card will now show the correct survival way

notes.title: Simfest and first update! 🌈
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have some exciting news to share! Diluvian Winds is now part of Simfest, a great Steam festival celebrating all things related to simulation games.

During Simfest, you'll have the opportunity to explore the latest and most thrilling simulation titles. And here's the best part: From today until July 24th, 2023 at 10 am PDT, you can enjoy a fantastic 20% discount on Diluvian Winds!

That's not all! We're also thrilled to announce the game's first update. We've added new settings and difficulties to the game modes (Story, Sandbox, and Scoring). Plus, we've introduced a photo mode so you can easily share beautiful screenshots with your friends!

Make sure to check out the full patchnote for all the details:

[expand type=patchnote]
Summary

-New sandbox settings
-New scoring and story difficulties (easy and hard)
-A new photo mode
-Quality of life improvements
-Bug fixes and balancing

/!\ KNOWN BUGS /!\

-Loading an old save in story mode (saved before update 0.6.0) may result in a soft lock (the query you need to perform in order to progress is not present)
-Localization is not complete for some languages

GAME MODES 

We've added a seed system for the scoring and sandbox game modes. It allows you to have the same start using the same seed and the same parameters when launching a game.

Story
Two new difficulty modes: Easy and Hard.

Sandbox
-New parameters for customizing a game
-Disaster on/off
-Disaster phase frequency
-Intervals between disasters
-Rainbow weather duration
-Quantity of plans obtained
-Starting prototype points
-Fire weather penalty
-Morale weather penalty
-Quantity of starting resources
-Overheating gauge size
-Number of restarts in the caravan

Scoring (BETA)
-Two new difficulty modes: Easy and Hard

PHOTO MODE

We've also added a photo mode. Take your best in-game photos and share them with your friend!
It includes the following settings: 
-Staging

-Lighthouse light orientation

notes.title: 📅 EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We're super excited to announce Dluvian Winds will launch in early access on May 25th!

Here's the latest trailer we've made for the occasion:

[previewyoutube=RoO3q_ToAck;full][/previewyoutube]

EARLY ACCESS CONTENT:

 2 survival paths: Land and Underwater
 10 traveler species: Otter, Beaver, Bear, Mouse, Squirrel, Turtle, Salamander, Duck, Frog and Kingfisher
 35 rooms
 5 story chapters
 Sandbox mode
 Daily runs (beta): score system and limited time, but no run modifiers

Of course, we've planned more content during early access and we can't wait to show you more through our roadmap. Stay tuned for that! 👀

PRICING:

Diluvian Winds will be priced at $17,99 / €17,99 / £15,99 with a 10% launch discount for a week.
We may slightly increase this pricing after early access.

WISHLIST NOW:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561040/Diluvian_Winds/

Until launch, feel free to join us on our Discord server if you have any questions for us!

We can't wait for you to play Diluvian Winds and get your feedback!
